title: Transitivity $T_{F,\Qlb}\circ T_{E,F}\cong T_{E,\Qlb}$
statement:
For a prime $\ell$, a scheme $X$ and finite extensions $E\le F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside
$\Qlb$, there is a natural isomorphism

$$
T_{F,\Qlb}\circ T_{E,F}\;\cong\;T_{E,\Qlb}\colon D(\Mod_{E_X})\longrightarrow
D(\Mod_{\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}})
$$

between the derived extensions of scalars of [def-sfb-derived-extend-subfield] and
[def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar].

proof.text: Write $A=\operatorname{Ext}_{E_X\to F_X}$, $B=\operatorname{Ext}_{F_X\to\QbarX}$ and $C=\operatorname{Ext}_{E_X\to\QbarX}$. All are right exact by [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars](2). Their finite-limit preservation is [lem-sfb-subfield-flat] for $A$ and [lem-sfb-qlbar-flat] for $B,C$. Thus they are exact. The functors in the statement are $LA,LB,LC$ by [def-sfb-derived-extend-subfield] and [def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar].

source.place: Single proof paragraph, expanded along its exact-scalar-extension route

proof.text: Put $\varphi:E_X\to F_X$ and $\psi:F_X\to\QbarX$. The action on $\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}\operatorname{Res}_{\psi}N$ is $\gamma_N(\psi\otimes1)(\varphi\otimes1)=\gamma_N((\psi\varphi)\otimes1)$, and both restrictions leave underlying maps unchanged. Hence their composite equals $\operatorname{Res}_{\psi\varphi}$. Pasting the adjunction Hom bijections of [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars](2) gives $BA\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{\psi\varphi}$.

source.place: Single proof paragraph, expanded along its exact-scalar-extension route

proof.text: Both $BA$ and $\operatorname{Ext}_{\psi\varphi}$ are left adjoint to that restriction, so [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] gives their unit-compatible isomorphism. The coefficient-map identity [lem-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map-comp], followed by [def-sfb-extend-scalars-iso-of-eq], identifies the latter extension with $C$. Denote the resulting isomorphism by $\theta:BA\xrightarrow{\sim}C$.

source.place: Single proof paragraph, expanded along its exact-scalar-extension route

proof.text:
The exact-functor clause of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] identifies $LA,LB,LC$ with $D(A),D(B),D(C)$. Apply [lem-sfb-exact-derived-composition] to $A,B$ and [lem-sfb-exact-derived-natural-iso] to $\theta$. Composing these comparisons gives
$$T_{F,\Qlb}T_{E,F}\cong D(B)D(A)\xrightarrow{\mu_{A,B}^{-1}}D(BA)\xrightarrow{D(\theta)}D(C)\cong T_{E,\Qlb}.$$
All comparisons are natural on the full unbounded derived categories.
